title: Pivot: build the pricing practice with Deneffe Consulting
summary: Instead of building the pricing practice alone, build it with Dan Deneffe (deneffeconsulting.com), your mentor and former Harvard and MBA professor, as two experts. He brings a proven method and senior credibility; you bring AI and usage-based pricing, a content engine, LatAm reach and fixed-scope delivery. Fixed-scope offers run on his methods and feed full engagements that he leads. Test it as a 90-day, non-exclusive pilot before formalising.

Defence against low-priced entrants: fighting brands, switching costs
Credibility: HBR, MIT Sloan and Forbes coverage, Fad-Free Strategy; client results of 1,000%+ ROI, +16.3% contribution margin, +1.4% annual margin
EU and US client base, including an AI SaaS client (Trendtracker.ai)

economics: Illustrative year one: 12 Diagnostics at about US$3.5k, 4 studies at US$12k, 2 engagements at US$40k, US$10k of licences = about US$184k joint revenue for about 184 of Dan's hours. Assumptions only; the pilot replaces them with real numbers.
terms: 15% of the fee to whoever brings the client, taken off the top
Remainder by role per offer, e.g. Diagnostic 80/20 (Calebe/Dan), Study 50/50, Engagement 30/70

pilot: Agree terms and a one-page IP note; scope the Diagnostic and the study using Dan's method; one co-branded offer page with booking link

success_bar: Day 90: 3+ paid Diagnostics, 1 study signed, 1 full engagement in qualified pipeline, under 15 h/month of Dan's time. Hit it: formalise and scale. Miss it: stop, or keep only referrals.
impact: Moves the pricing practice's ceiling from US$2.9k Diagnostics and US$7.9k Sprints toward US$25-60k co-delivered engagements, and should lift conversion through Dan's credibility. Costs: revenue shared on every deal and dependence on one partner's time and goodwill; agree IP ownership in writing before building joint products. Fallback if he declines: the solo playbook below stands unchanged.
